_note: Synthetic mail and chat. Weighted to 2026-09-03/04 so 'what did I miss' has real material. No real addresses.

messages.subject: ADR-014 published: Redis for Helix sessions
messages.body: Wrote up the session store decision from this afternoon. Redis wins on read latency at projected peak; Postgres was 34ms p99 against 3ms. ADR-014 is in the repo.

messages.subject: Auroria reducing refresh token lifetime to 14 days on Sep 18
messages.body: Auroria confirmed the change is firm and there are no exemptions. Any service holding refresh tokens longer than 14 days needs rotation implemented before 2026-09-18.

messages.subject: KT recording
messages.body: Recording from this morning is uploaded. I covered the refresh path, the Redis session layout and the deploy config. There are a couple of things I genuinely don't know the answer to - flagged them at the end.

messages.subject: ADR-016: Helix read path moving to stateless JWT
messages.body: We took this in today's review. Read-only endpoints will validate a stateless JWT instead of hitting the session store. Write paths keep the Redis session from ADR-014. Kiran, you were out - flagging because it changes the shape of what you inherited.

messages.subject: Helix release pulled forward to Friday Sep 11
messages.body: We're moving the release a week earlier so we aren't shipping on the same day the Auroria policy lands. Please confirm your readiness inputs by Tuesday.

messages.subject: AUTH-247 assigned to you
messages.body: Assigning refresh-token rotation to you now that the handover is done. Due Sep 16, but note the release moved to Sep 11. Also assigned AUTH-251 for the runbook.

messages.subject: New standard: ADR required for token lifetime changes
messages.body: Effective immediately, any change to token lifetime or rotation policy requires an approved ADR before merge. Follows the Q2 mobile client incident.

messages.subject: Security questionnaire for Auroria migration
messages.body: Need your answers on sections 3 and 4 by Wednesday so I can close the vendor risk sign-off.

messages.subject: Monday architecture review
messages.body: Putting you down to present the refresh-token position on Monday at 3. Bring a written position, not slides - we'll argue about it in the room.

messages.subject: URGENT: payments hotfix awaiting your approval
messages.body: The payments hotfix is sitting in the approval queue and the release team is blocked. Need your sign-off before 11:00 today.

messages.subject: Release readiness inputs
messages.body: Also need your readiness inputs for Helix ahead of tomorrow's 11:00 session.

messages.subject: PR #1183
messages.body: Any chance you can look at #1183 this week? It's the last thing open on my side before I'm fully off the squad.

messages.subject: Reminder: Security Awareness FY26 due Sep 10
messages.body: Your mandatory Security Awareness FY26 training is 40 percent complete and due on 2026-09-10.

messages.subject: This week's menu
messages.body: Monday: pasta bar. Tuesday: south Indian.

messages.subject: Welcome back
messages.body: Welcome back. Let's use the 1:1 today to talk through how the handover landed - I know a lot moved while you were out.
